Do-files install `pkg', tuples from the network at run time, with no version pinned and no copy bundled. SSC serves the current version, which may differ from the authors'.
Requires Stata (version 10.1, 11 named in code); the desk says it has it.

Files the code both writes and reads are already in the package: data/teacher_covars.dta. A run may read these instead of recomputing them. A receipt must say whether it replayed them or recomputed them, and a matching output hash alone does not show recomputation.
44 file reads use paths built at run time (macros, globs, variables), so triage could not check that those inputs exist.
The package mentions a cluster or batch scheduler; scripts may assume one.
